🚀 Pull Request

📝 Description
Please provide a clear summary of the changes made, the problem they solve, and the necessary context for the review.

🛠️ Type of Change

- [ ] 🐞 Bug fix
- [ ] ✨ New feature
- [ ] ⚡ Performance improvement
- [ ] ♻️ Refactor
- [ ] 📚 Documentation
- [ ] 🔧 Config/Tools
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (requires special attention)

🧪 Tests Performed
Describe the tests you performed to verify your changes. Include instructions so others can reproduce them.

- [ ] Unit tests: (e.g., uv run pytest)
- [ ] Local verification: (e.g., cd ecuador && uv run python main.py)
- [ ] Other tests: (Detail here, e.g., DWH data verification)

✅ Quality Checklist
Please check the applicable boxes before submitting the PR.

- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, especially in complex or hard-to-understand areas.
- [ ] I have updated the corresponding documentation (README, internal docs, etc.).
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings.
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] All existing tests pass locally with uv.
- [ ] I have verified that static types are correct (if applicable).
- [ ] I have synchronized dependencies with uv sync if there were changes in pyproject.toml.

🔗 Related Links

- Closes: # (Issue ID)
- Related to: # (Other PRs or issues)

📸 Screenshots / Logs (if applicable)
Add screenshots, log snippets, or diagrams that help understand the impact of the changes.
